'''Stage IV Rooters''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Nexus Parasites|Nexus]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
Spawns after a [[Stage III Rooter]] evolves.

== ''Behavior'' ==

*Stage IV Rooters can summon multiple Ancient Pods, which will fall from the sky towards the ground. Few seconds after landing, they will explode inflicting 50 damage, release a Toxic Cloud giving Saturation -20 for 10 seconds and release an effect cloud of Poison for 15 seconds. Ancient Pods from a Stage IV Rooter will not spawn any parasites. It must wait at least 12 seconds before it can summon Pods again, and a maximum of 5 can spawn.
*Stage IV Rooters throw 8 bombs around them when damaged, this has a cooldown of 5 seconds. These bombs inflict 22 damage each and place an effect cloud of [[Viral]] and Poison.
*Stage IV Rooters can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 18, with a 20-tick cooldown and 5 block range.
*Stage IV Rooters will permanently upgrade parasites by increasing their [[Generations|generation]] to max value.
*Stage IV Rooters will hide their tentacles if terrain around them is too small.
*Stage IV Rooters will apply the following effects to parasites:
**[[Pivot]] III (0:15)
**[[Parate]] III (0:15)
*Stage IV Rooters can summon [[Rootmass Cyst|Rootmass Cysts]] when damaged.
* Upon death, if at least one [[Colony]] exists in the dimension, Stage IV Rooters will turn into [[Stage III Rooter|Stage III Rooters]].

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
* Stage IV Rooters, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* The topmost point on the Stage IV Rooter functions as a Weak Point. When this Weak Point is hit, damage inflicted to it is tripled and the [[Bleeding]] Effect is applied to it.

== ''Trivia'' ==
* Like all Nexuses, Stage IV Rooters do not despawn by default.
* Stage IV Rooters are also known as '''LeemSIV''' in the Mod Files.
